svg.title: Open AD Kit: Autoware as images, deployments and one command
svg.desc: Open AD Kit packages Autoware into component images: sensing-perception, localization-mapping, planning, control and vehicle-system, with a simulator and a visualizer. Deployments combine them into ready-to-run stacks: Planning, Scenario, Logging, CARLA and Safety Island Simulation, and your own kit puts your vehicle on top of one. openadkit run starts a deployment on an Ubuntu host with Docker Compose, split over two hosts, or on in-vehicle Linux with AutoSD. Caption: one reproducible path from simulation to in-vehicle systems.
